62	const SHEET = new Int32Array(TILE_DEFS.length).fill(-1);
63	for (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {
64	  const s = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;
65	  if (typeof s === 'number') SHEET[i] = s;
66	}
67	const REV = new Map<number, number>();
68	for (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {
69	  const s = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;
70	  if (typeof s === 'number' && !REV.has(s)) REV.set(s, i);

72	const DUMPNAME = new Map<number, string>();
73	for (const f of readdirSync(G2)) { const m = /^(\d{3})_(.+)\.typ$/.exec(f); if (m) DUMPNAME.set(Number(m[1]), m[2]); }
74	
75	const gPath = (idx: number, ext: string) => `${G2}/${String(idx).padStart(3, '0')}_${DUMPNAME.get(idx)}.${ext}`;
76	interface Ch { t: Uint16Array; a: Uint8Array; w: Uint16Array; l: Uint8Array; hf: Uint8Array; sl: Uint8Array; lt: Uint8Array; ia: Uint8Array }
77	const chCache = new Map<number, Ch>();
78	function chans(idx: number): Ch {
79	  const hit = chCache.get(idx);
80	  if (hit) return hit;
81	  const b8 = (e: string) => new Uint8Array(readFileSync(gPath(idx, e)).buffer.slice(0));
82	  const b16 = (e: string) => new Uint16Array(readFileSync(gPath(idx, e)).buffer.slice(0));
83	  const c: Ch = { t: b16('typ'), a: b8('act'), w: b16('wal'), l: b8('liq'), hf: b8('half'), sl: b8('slope'), lt: b8('lty'), ia: b8('inact') };
84	  chCache.set(idx, c);
85	  if (chCache.size > 8) chCache.delete(chCache.keys().next().value!);
86	  return c;
87	}

89	interface Boundary { gs: GenState; gensolid: Map<number, boolean>; fx: Uint16Array; fy: Uint16Array; wire: Uint8Array; ids35: Map<number, number>; chests: unknown[] }
90	const bCache = new Map<string, Boundary>();
91	function boundary(key: string): Boundary {
92	  const hit = bCache.get(key);
93	  if (hit) return hit;
94	  const dir = `${BDIR}/${key}`;
95	  if (!existsSync(`${dir}/gs.json`)) throw new Error(`no boundary ${key}`);
96	  const gs = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/gs.json`, 'utf8')) as GenState;
97	  const gensolid = new Map(JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/gensolid.json`, 'utf8')) as Array<[number, boolean]>);
98	  const fw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${dir}/frames.bin`).buffer.slice(0));
99	  const fx = new Uint16Array(N), fy = new Uint16Array(N), wire = new Uint8Array(N);
100	  for (let q = 0; q < fw.length; q += 4) { const i = fw[q]!; fx[i] = fw[q + 1]!; fy[i] = fw[q + 2]!; wire[i] = fw[q + 3]! & 0x1f; }
101	  const iw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${dir}/ids35.bin`).buffer.slice(0));
102	  const ids35 = new Map<number, number>();
103	  for (let q = 0; q < iw.length; q += 2) ids35.set(iw[q]!, iw[q + 1]!);
104	  const chests = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/chests.json`, 'utf8')) as unknown[];
105	  const b: Boundary = { gs, gensolid, fx, fy, wire, ids35, chests };
106	  bCache.set(key, b);
107	  return b;
108	}
109	
110	interface PrevOut { type: Uint16Array; flags: Uint8Array; fx: Uint16Array; fy: Uint16Array; wire: Uint8Array }
111	function buildHybrid(baseIdx: number, b: Boundary | PrevOut): { st: TileStore; revMiss: number } {
112	  const c = chans(baseIdx);
113	  const st = new TileStore(W, H);
114	  const fromB = 'ids35' in b;
115	  const ids35 = fromB ? (b as Boundary).ids35 : null;
116	  let revMiss = 0;
117	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
118	    const act = c.a[i]!;
119	    st.flags[i] = act;
120	    if (act || c.t[i]) {
121	      const sh = c.t[i]!;
122	      let id = ids35 && ids35.has(i) ? ids35.get(i)! : -1;
123	      if (id < 0 || SHEET[id] !== sh) { id = REV.get(sh) ?? -1; }
124	      if (id < 0) { id = 0; revMiss++; }
125	      st.type[i] = id;
126	    } else st.type[i] = 0;
127	    st.wall[i] = c.w[i]!;
128	    st.liquid[i] = c.l[i]!;
129	    st.liquidType[i] = c.l[i] ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
130	    st.half[i] = c.hf[i]!;
131	    st.slope[i] = c.sl[i]!;
132	    st.wire[i] = c.ia[i]! ? 0x20 : 0;
133	    if (fromB) {
134	      const bb = b as Boundary;
135	      st.frameX[i] = bb.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = bb.fy[i];
136	      st.wire[i] |= bb.wire[i];
137	    } else {
138	      const p = b as PrevOut;
139	      st.frameX[i] = p.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = p.fy[i];
140	      st.wire[i] |= p.wire[i] & 0x1f;
141	    }
142	  }
143	  return { st, revMiss };
144	}
145	const prevOf = (st: TileStore): PrevOut => ({ type: st.type.slice(), flags: st.flags.slice(), fx: st.frameX.slice(), fy: st.frameY.slice(), wire: st.wire.slice() });

147	// ---- 八通道 diff（_mile8 cmp 口径）----
148	interface Row { idx: number; tag: string; dA: number; dT: number; dW: number; dL: number; dHf: number; dSl: number; dLt: number; dIa: number; first: string; pairs: Array<[string, number]>; samples: string[] }
149	function diffStore(tag: string, idx: number, st: TileStore): Row {
150	  const c = chans(idx);
151	  const r: Row = { idx, tag, dA: 0, dT: 0, dW: 0, dL: 0, dHf: 0, dSl: 0, dLt: 0, dIa: 0, first: '', pairs: [], samples: [] };
152	  const pair = new Map<string, number>();
153	  let firstI = -1;
154	  const mark = (i: number) => { if (firstI < 0) firstI = i; };
155	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
156	    const va = c.a[i]!, ja = st.flags[i]! & 1;
157	    if (va !== ja) { r.dA++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`A(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${va} j${ja}`); }
158	    const vt = va ? c.t[i]! : 0;
159	    const jt = ja ? (SHEET[st.type[i]!] >= 0 ? SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 9999) : 0;
160	    if (vt !== jt) { r.dT++; mark(i); const k = `T${vt}>${jt}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`T(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vt} j${jt}`); }
161	    if (c.w[i]! !== st.wall[i]!) { r.dW++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`W(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.w[i]} j${st.wall[i]}`); }
162	    if (c.l[i]! !== st.liquid[i]!) { r.dL++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`L(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.l[i]} j${st.liquid[i]}`); }
163	    if (c.hf[i]! !== st.half[i]!) { r.dHf++; mark(i); const k = `H${c.hf[i]}>${st.half[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`H(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.hf[i]} j${st.half[i]}`); }
164	    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }
165	    const vl = c.l[i]! > 0 ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
166	    const jl = st.liquid[i]! > 0 ? st.liquidType[i]! : 0;
167	    if (vl !== jl) { r.dLt++; mark(i); const k = `Y${vl}>${jl}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`Y(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vl} j${jl} liq${c.l[i]}`); }
168	    const via = c.ia[i]! ? 1 : 0;
169	    const jia = (st.wire[i]! >>> 5) & 1;
170	    if (via !== jia) { r.dIa++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`I(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${via} j${jia}`); }
171	  }
172	  if (firstI >= 0) r.first = `(${firstI % W},${Math.floor(firstI / W)})`;
173	  r.pairs = [...pair.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8).map(([k, n]) => [k, n] as [string, number]);
174	  return r;
175	}
176	const isClean = (r: Row) => !(r.dA || r.dT || r.dW || r.dL || r.dHf || r.dSl || r.dLt || r.dIa);
177	function printRow(r: Row): void {
178	  const bad = !isClean(r);
179	  console.log(`${String(r.idx).padStart(3)} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} ← ${r.tag.padEnd(28)} ` +
180	    `A=${String(r.dA).padStart(6)} T=${String(r.dT).padStart(6)} W=${String(r.dW).padStart(5)} L=${String(r.dL).padStart(5)} ` +
181	    `Hf=${String(r.dHf).padStart(5)} Sl=${String(r.dSl).padStart(5)} Lt=${String(r.dLt).padStart(4)} Ia=${String(r.dIa).padStart(4)} ${bad ? '✗ ' + r.first : '✓'}`);
182	  if (bad) {
183	    console.log(`     pairs: ${r.pairs.map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
184	    console.log(`     samples: ${r.samples.join(' | ')}`);
185	  }
186	}

197	/** 跨槽生产者重算：shrineSpots / oceanTreasures（golden47/36 干净基座 + m_ 中途边界） */
198	function computeProducers(): { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> } {
199	  const mj = boundary('m_JungleShrines');
200	  const { st: stJ } = buildHybrid(47, mj);
201	  restoreGenSolid(mj.gensolid);
202	  const shrineSpots = runJungleShrinePass(stJ, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mj.gs) as GenState);
203	  const mo = boundary('m_OceanCaves');
204	  const { st: stO } = buildHybrid(36, mo);
205	  restoreGenSolid(mo.gensolid);
206	  const oceanTreasures = runOceanCavesPass(stO, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mo.gs) as GenState);
207	  return { shrineSpots, oceanTreasures };
208	}

210	async function runSettleStep(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, world: World): Promise<void> {
211	  world.store = st;
212	  world.shimmerX = gs.shimmerX; world.shimmerY = gs.shimmerY;
213	  world.genWaterLine = gs.waterLine;
214	  if ((gs.dungeonSide as number) === 0) world.genDungeonExempt = null;
215	  else {
216	    const edge = Math.floor(world.w * 0.05), mid = Math.floor(world.w * 0.55);
217	    world.genDungeonExempt = gs.dungeonSide < 0
218	      ? { x0: edge, x1: Math.floor(world.w * 0.45), y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 }
219	      : { x0: mid, x1: world.w - edge, y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 };
220	  }
221	  await settleWorldLiquids(world, 'gen', undefined, rng);
222	  flipGenSolid([484], false);
223	}

// .wld 地图解析器（Terraria 1.4+，version >= 210）
// 格式参考 TEdit（Terraria-Map-Editor）的 World.FileV2.cs，此处为独立 TS 实现。
// 只支持读取：section header / header flags / tiles（RLE）/ chests / town npcs。
// bestiary 等尾部 section 通过 sectionPointers 跳过，不做 footer 校验。
import { BinaryReaderLE } from './BinaryReaderLE';

export interface WldTileData {
  active: Uint8Array;    // active 标志（dirt 的 id 是 0，必须用此数组区分空气）
  type: Uint16Array;
  frameX: Uint16Array;
  frameY: Uint16Array;
  wall: Uint16Array;
  liquid: Uint8Array;
  liquidType: Uint8Array; // 1水 2岩浆 3蜂蜜
  wire: Uint8Array;       // 电路位 bit0红 bit1蓝 bit2绿 bit3黄 bit4致动器 bit5已致动（红蓝绿=header2 0x02-0x08,其余=header3）
  half: Uint8Array;       // 半砖(WorldFile.cs:1519 header2>>4 & 0x7 == 1)
  slope: Uint8Array;      // 坡面 1-4(== 2-5;Tile.cs sTileHeader bits 12-14 编码)
  paint: Uint8Array;      // 方块油漆 0-31（WorldFile.cs:2571-2574 header3 0x08 位后随 1 字节）
  paintWall: Uint8Array;  // 墙油漆 0-31（WorldFile.cs:2583-2586 header3 0x10 位后随 1 字节）
}

export interface WldChest { x: number; y: number; name: string; items: Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null>; }
export interface WldNPC { spriteId: number; name: string; x: number; y: number; homeX: number; homeY: number; }

export interface WldWorld {
  version: number;
function decodeTiles(
  r: BinaryReaderLE, w: number, h: number,
  version: number, frameImportant: boolean[],
): WldTileData {
  const n = w * h;
  const active = new Uint8Array(n);
  const type = new Uint16Array(n);
  const frameX = new Uint16Array(n);
  const frameY = new Uint16Array(n);
  const wall = new Uint16Array(n);
  const liquid = new Uint8Array(n);
  const liquidType = new Uint8Array(n);
  const wire = new Uint8Array(n);
  const half = new Uint8Array(n);

            byte[] act = new byte[n];
            byte[] wal = new byte[n * 2];

                    ushort ty2 = t.type;
                    typ[i * 2] = (byte)(ty2 & 0xFF);
                    typ[i * 2 + 1] = (byte)(ty2 >> 8);
                    act[i] = t.active() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                    ushort wv = t.wall;
                    wal[i * 2] = (byte)(wv & 0xFF);
                    wal[i * 2 + 1] = (byte)(wv >> 8);
                    liq[i] = t.liquid;
                    if (hs != null)
                    {
                        half[i] = t.halfBrick() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                        slope[i] = (byte)t.slope();
                        lty[i] = (byte)t.liquidType();
                        ina[i] = t.inActive() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                    }
                }
            File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".typ", typ);
            File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".act", act);
            File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".wal", wal);
            File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".liq", liq);
            if (hs != null)
            {
                File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".half", half);
                File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".slope", slope);
                File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".lty", lty);
                File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".inact", ina);
            }
        }

/** OceanCaves pass(cs:15228):地牢侧海洋 1/3 概率一条;返回宝藏点集(UnderwaterChests 消费) */
export function runOceanCavesPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): Array<{ x: number; y: number }> {
  // 一次性探针钩（同 WebsPass 模式）：OceanCaves 入口快照（债时间线用）
  const g0 = globalThis as { __swOcCap?: (gs: GenState, st: TileStore) => void };
  try { g0.__swOcCap?.(gs, st); } catch { /* probe */ }
  const treasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> = [];
  const { w } = st;
  for (const side of [0, 1] as const) {
    // 左海洋仅当地牢在左(dungeonSide < Right)、右海洋仅当在右(cs:15243)
    if (side === 0 && gs.dungeonSide !== -1) continue;
    if (side === 1 && gs.dungeonSide !== 1) continue;
    if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) continue; // 1/3
    // ★cs:15249-15252:`int num = genRand.Next(55, 95); if (i == 1) num = Next(w-95, w-55);`
    //   右洋(i==1)的首次 Next(55,95) 被丢弃但**消耗掷骰流**——此前 JS 只掷一次,
    //   右洋蠕虫后续全部掷骰错位(8888 种子对拍实锤:HARDSAND/SAND 壳层错写 ~13k 格)。
    let x: number;
    if (side === 0) x = rng.int(55, 94);
    else { rng.int(55, 94); x = rng.int(w - 95, w - 56); }
    let j = 0;
    while (j < st.h && !activeAt(st, x, j)) j++;
    if (j >= st.h) continue;
    treasures.push(...oceanCave(st, rng, gs, x, j));
  }
  return treasures;
}

/** UnderwaterChests pass 的宝藏点段（cs:17348-17368）1:1：
 *  主件 NextFromList [863,186,277,187,4404]；num 自 2.0 起步进 0.1 扩窗重试
 *  （<50），采样域 [x±num, y±num/2]（上界 +1 含端），越右界回折 num/2；
 *  命中液体 ≥250 且为水 → AddBuriedChest(style17, trySlope:true)。 */
export function runUnderwaterChestsPass(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, treasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>,
): void {
  for (const t of treasures) {
    const main = [863, 186, 277, 187, 4404][rng.int(0, 4)];        // NextFromList
    let num = 2.0;
    for (;;) {
      if (num >= 50.0) break;
      num += 0.1;
      let x = rng.int(t.x - Math.floor(num), t.x + Math.floor(num));    // Next(x-num, x+num+1)
      const y = rng.int(t.y - Math.floor(num / 2), t.y + Math.floor(num / 2));
      // cs:17362：num2 越右界 → 折回 num/2（InWorld 由 placeBuriedChest 自行兜底）
      x = x >= st.w ? Math.floor(x + num / 2) : Math.floor(x - num / 2);
      if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
        const i = st.idx(x, y);
        // liquidType 修 2026-08-12:同 BuriedChestsPass——本仓库 +1 编码,水=LIQUID_TYPE.WATER
        // (原 ===0 永假 → 海洋洞窟水中箱特性静默失效)
        if (st.liquid[i] > 250 && st.liquidType[i] === LIQUID_TYPE.WATER) {
          if (placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y, {
            style: 17, loot: main, flags: { water: true }, trySlope: true,
          })) break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

it : it.skip)('water chest placement sequence', async () => {\n  const entry = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${BDIR}/s17/gs.json`, 'utf8')) as GenState;\n  const gensolid = new Map(JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${BDIR}/s17/gensolid.json`, 'utf8')) as Array<[number, boolean]>);\n  const ids35raw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${BDIR}/s17/ids35.bin`).buffer.slice(0));\n  const ids35 = new Map<number, number>();\n  for (let q = 0; q < ids35raw.length; q += 2) ids35.set(ids35raw[q]!, ids35raw[q + 1]!);\n  const c57 = { t: u16(57), a: u8(57), w: u16(57), l: u8(57), hf: u8(57), sl: u8(57), lt: u8(57), ia: u8(57) };\n  function u8(i: number) { return new Uint8Array(readFileSync(`${G2}/${pad(i)}.act`).buffer.slice(0)); }\n  function u16(i: number) { return new Uint16Array(readFileSync(`${G2}/${pad(i)}.typ`).buffer.slice(0)); }\n  function pad(i: number) { return `${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}_${DUMPNAME.get(i)}`; }\n  // frames from s17 boundary\n  const fw = new Uint32Array(readFileSync(`${BDIR}/s17/frames.bin`).buffer.slice(0));\n  const fx = new Uint16Array(N), fy = new Uint16Array(N), wire = new Uint8Array(N);\n  for (let q = 0; q < fw.length; q += 4) { const i = fw[q]!; fx[i] = fw[q + 1]!; fy[i] = fw[q + 2]!; wire[i] = fw[q + 3]! & 0x1f; }\n  // build hybrid at base 61 (need intermediate states 58..61 though — replay the steps!)\n  const st = new TileStore(W, H);\n  const build = (ch: typeof c57) => {\n    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {\n      const act = ch.a[i]!;\n      st.flags[i] = act;\n      if (act || ch.t[i]) {\n        let id = ids35.has(i) ? ids35.get(i)! : -1;\n        if (id < 0 || SHEET[id] !== ch.t[i]) id = REV.get(ch.t[i]!) ?? -1;\n        st.type[i] = id < 0 ? 0 : id;\n      } else st.type[i] = 0;\n      st.wall[i] = ch.w[i]!;\n      st.liquid[i] = ch.l[i]!;\n      st.liquidType[i] = ch.l[i] ? ids35.get(i)! : -1;\n      const sh = p.t[i]!;\n      if (id < 0 || SHEET[id] !== sh) id = REV.get(sh) ?? -1;\n      st.type[i] = (act || sh) && id >= 0 ? id : 0;\n      st.frameX[i] = p.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = p.fy[i]; st.wire[i] = p.wr[i]!;\n    }\n  }\n  // dump59 步\n  rng = new RNG(SEED);\n  flipGenSolid([226, 162, 225, 190], true);\n  rollHouseChestCounts(st, rng, gs);\n  runBuriedChestsPass(st, rng, gs, chests);\n  runUnderworldChestsPass(st, rng, gs, chests);\n  runCaveHousesPass(st, rng, gs, chests);\n  flipGenSolid([226, 162, 225, 190], false);\n  buildFromPrev(prevOf());\n  // dump60/61 步\n  rng = new RNG(SEED);\n  runSurfaceChestsPass(st, rng, gs, chests);\n  buildFromPrev(prevOf());\n  rng = new RNG(SEED);\n  const shrineSpots = [/* producers 重算省略——61 步只消费,若 shrineSpots 影响流则需真值 */];\n  console.log('NOTE: shrineSpots 省略——61 步流若依赖会偏(仅用于定位 62 步落点序)');\n  // dump62 步：打点\n  const pushes: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> = [];\n  const sinkProxy = new Proxy(chests, {\n    set(target, prop, value) {\n      if (prop === 'length' || (typeof prop === 'string' && !isNaN(Number(prop)))) {\n        // push 写 index\n      }\n      return Reflect.set(target, prop, value);\n    },\n  }) as ChestSink;\n  const before = chests.length;\n  rng = new RNG(SEED);\n  runUnderwaterChestsPass(st, rng, gs, sinkProxy, []);\n  runWaterChestsPass(st, rng, gs, sinkProxy);\n  const added = chests.slice(before);\n  console.log(`JS water-chest step sink adds: ${added.length}`);\n  console.log(added.map((c: { x: number; y: number }) => `(${c.x},${c.y})`).join(' '));\n  const van = [[2163,725],[617,782],[4133,342],[1459,467],[3461,467],[3025,352],[60,293],[3061,555],[3507,313],[3097,801],[98,292],[3268,615],[4100,340],[834,509],[150,284],[3599,497],[392,245],[816,818]];\n  console.log('vanilla NC: ' + van.map(([x, y]) => `(${x},${y})`).join(' '));\n  __setGenStateForProbe(null);\n});\n"

  private getSampleForLargeRange(): number {
    let num = this.internalSample();
    if (this.internalSample() % 2 === 0) num = -num;
    return (num + 2147483646) / 4294967293;
  }

  /** C# Next()（:106-108）：裸 int32 */
  next(): number {
    return this.internalSample();
  }

  /** C# Next(minValue, maxValue)（:115-133）：[min, max)。maxValue 负值时 C# 抛异常，
   *  本移植不抛（生成期契约保证入参合法）。*/
  nextIntRange(minValue: number, maxValue: number): number {
    const num = maxValue - minValue; // C# long 减法，≤2^32，JS 精确
    if (num <= 2147483647) {
      return (Math.trunc(this.sample() * num) + minValue) | 0;
    }
    return (Math.trunc(this.getSampleForLargeRange() * num) + minValue) | 0;
  }

  /** C# Next(maxValue)（:121-127）：[0, max) */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return Math.trunc(this.sample() * maxValue);
  }

  /** C# NextDouble()（:113-115）*/
  nextDouble(): number {
    return this.sample();
  }

  /** C# Peek()（:88-99，非消耗）：下一 InternalSample 原始差值——对账/断点用 */
  peek(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    return this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
  }
}

// ── RNG：世界生成/运行时统一入口（API 不变，内核换 UnifiedRandom）──────────
// 与原版调用点的对账约定（gen 代码全部按此书写）：
//   rng.next()   = NextDouble()          每次消耗 1 个 InternalSample
//   rng.int(a,b) = Next(a, b+1)          闭区间 [a,b]
//   rng.chance(p)= NextDouble() < p      1 次
//   rng.pick(xs) = xs[Next(xs.length)]   1 次
//   rng.range(a,b) = a + NextDouble()*(b-a)
export class RNG {
  private ur: UnifiedRandom;
  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.ur = new UnifiedRandom(seed);
  }

  next(): number {
    return this.ur.nextDouble();
  }

  /** 闭区间 [min, max]，≡ 原版 Next(min, max+1) */
  int(min: number, max: number): number {
    return this.ur.nextIntRange(min, max + 1);
  }

  range(min: number, max: number): number {
    return min + this.ur.nextDouble() * (max - min);
  }

  chance(p: number): boolean {
    return this.ur.nextDouble() < p;
  }

  pick<T>(arr: T[]): T {
    return arr[this.ur.nextInt(arr.length)];
  }

  /** 原版裸方法直通（Reset 序列/pass 级对账用，语义与 C# 完全一致） */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return this.ur.nextInt(maxValue);
  }

  /** RunPass 种子重播（1456 WorldGenerator.cs:497：每个 GenPass 执行前
   *  `Main.rand = new UnifiedRandom(_seed)`，IL 实证 newobj+stsfld Main::rand；

   *  第 0 掷开始，pass 间不续流）。原地重置内部流，保持对象引用——ctx.rng 与
   *  闭包捕获在重播后仍然有效。 */

  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++)

  return true;
}

function place2x1HF(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, tile: number, style: number): boolean {
  if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] || st.flags[st.idx(x + 1, y)]) return false;
  if (!solidTile2HF(st, x, y + 1) || !solidTile2HF(st, x + 1, y + 1)) return false;
  const fx = 36 * style;
  st.setTileSilent(x, y, tile, fx, 0);
  st.setTileSilent(x + 1, y, tile, fx + 18, 0);
  return true;
}

/** Place1x2（cs:46665,椅 15）：SolidTile2(x,y+1) 且 (x,y-1) 空；

29	function statueTileKey(sheet: number): number | null {
30	  for (let id = 0; id < TILE_DEFS.length; id++) {
31	    const d = TILE_DEFS[id];
32	    if (d && d.vanilla?.sheet === sheet && d.key.startsWith('v_')) return id;
33	  }
34	  return null;
35	}
36	
37	const STATUE_105 = statueTileKey(105);
38	const STATUE_349 = statueTileKey(349);
39	const TRAP = statueTileKey(135);   // cs:4451 PlaceTile(135)——超级飞镖陷阱（曾误 137）
40	const TRAP_162 = statueTileKey(162);
41	const WIRE_RED = TileStore.WIRE_RED;
42	
43	/** PlaceStatueTrap(cs:4436-4462)：±10 盒内找"空格+下方 SolidTile2 且非冰(162)"位放
44	 *  超级飞镖陷阱(135,曾误用 137)并 WireLine 拉红线——L 形拐点=(陷阱x,雕像y)
45	 *  （cs:111-129：横段沿 start(雕像)y、竖段沿 end(陷阱)x）。 */
46	export function placeStatueTrap(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {
47	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || x < 20 || x > st.w - 21 || y < 20 || y > st.h - 21 || !TRAP) return;
48	  for (let i = -10; i <= 10; i++) {
49	    for (let j = -10; j <= 10; j++) {
50	      const tx = x + i, ty = y + j;
51	      if (!st.inBounds(tx, ty + 1)) continue;
52	      const ci = st.idx(tx, ty), bi = st.idx(tx, ty + 1);
53	      if (st.flags[ci]) continue;                                   // !tile2.active()
54	      // SolidTile2(tile)（cs:70178）：active && 生成期 tileSolid && slope==0 && !halfBrick && !inActive
55	      if (!st.flags[bi] || st.half[bi] || st.slope[bi] !== 0 || ((st.wire[bi] >>> 5) & 1) === 1
56	        || !vanGenSolidType(st.type[bi])) continue;
57	      if (st.type[bi] === TRAP_162) continue;                       // tile.type != 162（冰特判）
58	      st.setTileSilent(tx, ty, TRAP, 0, 0);
59	      // WireLine(new Point(x,y), new Point(tx,ty))：横段沿雕像 y、竖段沿陷阱 x
60	      const x0 = Math.min(x, tx), x1 = Math.max(x, tx);
61	      const y0 = Math.min(y, ty), y1 = Math.max(y, ty);
62	      for (let wx = x0; wx <= x1; wx++) st.wire[st.idx(wx, y)] |= WIRE_RED;
63	      for (let wy = y0; wy <= y1; wy++) st.wire[st.idx(tx, wy)] |= WIRE_RED;
64	      return;
65	    }
66	  }
67	}

69	/** Statues pass 主体。须在洞穴/生物群系成形后调用(原版序:SettleLiquids 后、地下屋前) */
70	export function runStatuesPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
71	  // 一次性探针钩（同 WebsPass 模式）：Statues 入口快照（债时间线用）
72	  {
73	    const g0 = globalThis as { __swStatCap?: (gs: GenState, st: TileStore) => void };
74	    try { g0.__swStatCap?.(gs, st); } catch { /* probe */ }
75	  }
76	  if (!STATUE_105) return;
77	  const { w, h } = st;
78	  const count = Math.floor(STATUE.length * 2 * (w / 4200));
79	  let num = 0; // 样式序游标(cs:16970 顺序轮换)
80	  const yMin = Math.floor((gs.worldSurface * 2 + gs.rockLevel) / 3);
81	  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
82	    if (num >= STATUE.length) num = 0;
83	    const [sheet, style] = STATUE[num];
84	    let done = false;
85	    let fail = 0;
86	    while (!done) {
87	      let x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
88	      let y = rng.int(yMin, h - 301);
89	      // 海洋回避(cs:16989 oceanDepths)——y > oceanLevel 直接 false 必须前置：
90	      // 否则深层海滩列（y 超过海平面线）会被误拒重掷
91	      const oceanTop = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
92	      let guard = 100;
93	      while (y <= oceanTop && (x < gs.beachDistance || x > w - gs.beachDistance) && guard-- > 0) {
94	        x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
95	        y = rng.int(yMin, h - 301);
96	      }
97	      if (guard <= 0) { done = true; break; }
98	      // 向下扫到首个 active 格,雕像坐其上一格(cs:17014-17018)
99	      while (y < h && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) y++;
100	      if (y >= h) { done = true; break; }
101	      y--;
102	      // cs:17036 anyShimmer 门（PlaceTile 调用前置）+ cs:59501 PlaceTile 前奏
103	      // tile.Clear(Tile|TilePaint|Slope)：**任何失败尝试也会清** inactive 锚格的
104	      // half/slope/type/帧（golden 半砖位 v0 的来源；须在一切本地门之前——
105	      // 原版 pass 无边界门，PlaceTile 照调）。WWW 批 2026-08-18 接线。
106	      // ★PPPP 补 else-if 支（cs:59503-59507）：锚格 **活性** 且非 frameImportant 时
107	      //   ResetsHalfBrickPlacementAttempt[num]（105/349 不在例外表 → 恒 true）→
108	      //   halfBrick(false)+帧归零（type/active 保留）。触发场景=随机 y 落在岩体内 →
109	      //   下扫首格即活性 → y-- 锚到活性半砖泥/石 → 放置必败但半砖被原版清掉
110	      //   （#58 残余 7 Hf：(3063,475) 等七格 H0>1 的真身）。
111	      {
112	        const ai = st.idx(x, y);
113	        const shimmer = st.liquid[ai] > 0 && st.liquidType[ai] === 4 /* LIQ_SHIMMER */;
114	        if (!shimmer) {
115	          if (!st.flags[ai]) {
116	            st.half[ai] = 0; st.slope[ai] = 0; st.type[ai] = 0; st.frameX[ai] = 0; st.frameY[ai] = 0;
117	          } else if (!TILE_DEFS[st.type[ai]]?.framed) {
118	            st.half[ai] = 0; st.frameX[ai] = 0; st.frameY[ai] = 0;
119	          }
120	        }
121	      }
122	      if (y < 2 || !st.inBounds(x + 1, y - 2)) { fail++; if (fail >= 10000) { done = true; } continue; }
123	      // 2×3 净空(PlaceTile forced 语义:占用格须非 active)
124	      let ok = true;
125	      for (let dx = 0; dx < 2 && ok; dx++) {
126	        for (let dy = -2; dy <= 0 && ok; dy++) {
127	          if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) ok = false;
128	        }
129	      }
130	      // ★Place2xX 底座门（cs:39762）：SolidTile2(x,y+1) && SolidTile2(x+1,y+1)——
131	      //   SolidTile2（cs:70178）= active && 生成期 tileSolid && slope==0 && !halfBrick
132	      //   && !inActive（无 solidTop 条件，勿用 SolidTile）。曾整门缺失 → #58 干净基座
133	      //   下 100+ 雕像错位（半砖/坡面/非实心底座被误收）。WWW 批 2026-08-18 修。
134	      if (ok) {
135	        for (const bx of [x, x + 1]) {
136	          const bi = st.idx(bx, y + 1);
137	          if (!st.flags[bi] || st.half[bi] || st.slope[bi] !== 0
138	            || ((st.wire[bi] >>> 5) & 1) === 1 || !vanGenSolidType(st.type[bi])) { ok = false; break; }
139	        }
140	      }
141	      if (!ok) { fail++; if (fail >= 10000) { done = true; } continue; }
142	      const tile = sheet === 349 ? STATUE_349 : STATUE_105;
143	      if (!tile) { done = true; break; }
144	      // 雕像帧换行（PlaceTile case 105，cs:39716-39720）：每行 55 列——
145	      // frameX=(style%55)*36、frameY=floor(style/55)*54。此前单轴 style*36，
146	      // style≥55 全部越界错位（Tiles_105 宽 1980=55 列）
147	      const row = Math.floor(style / 55);
148	      for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
149	        for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
150	          st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y - 2 + dy, tile, (style - row * 55) * 36 + dx * 18, row * 54 + dy * 18);
151	        }
152	      }
153	      if (STATUES_WITH_TRAPS.has(num)) placeStatueTrap(st, x, y);
154	      num++;
155	      done = true;
156	    }
157	  }
158	}

/** SquareTileFrame（cs:80924）：九宫列主序，中心 resetFrame=true（178 掷门，永不中） */
function squareTileFrame(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number): void {
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y - 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y + 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y, true);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y - 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y + 1, false);
}

 *  vanilla 用 Actions.SetTile（setSelfFrames+setNeighborFrames 默认真）与
 *  Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors:true) 的所有 Gen 步骤，其邻帧 WorldGen.TileFrame
 *  会分派 frameImportant Check* 击杀链——典型：蜂蜜斑挖蜜池 ClearTile 四邻帧打到
 *  下方祭坛格 → Check3x2(26) 支撑失守 → KillTile×6 整坛坍塌（12345 链 #47 债）。
 *  - 'clearTile'：WorldUtils.ClearTile（cs:55-64）——先清本格（调用方自理）再四邻
 *    +x/-x/+y/-y，resetFrame=false；
 *  - 'setTile'：WorldUtils.TileFrame（cs:79-92）——中心 resetFrame=true 在前，
 *    四邻 resetFrame=true 在后。 */
export function genFrameNeighbors(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG,
  x: number, y: number,
  mode: 'clearTile' | 'setTile',
): void {
  const ctx: SweepCtx = { rng, destroyObject: false, frameSparse: false, stats: undefined };
  if (mode === 'clearTile') {
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, false);
  } else {
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, true);
  }
}

/** SquareTileFrame 生成期（cs:80924，九宫、仅中心 resetFrame=true）——
 *  FrameOutAllHiveContents 的 tile 侧等消费端（cs:22544 同构邻格击杀级联） */
export function genSquareTileFrame(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
  const ctx: SweepCtx = { rng, destroyObject: false, frameSparse: false, stats: undefined };
  squareTileFrame(st, ctx, x, y);
}

const roll3 = (ctx: SweepCtx): number => {
  if (ctx.stats) ctx.stats.roll184++;
  return ctx.rng ? ctx.rng.int(0, 2) : 0;
};
const rollRange = (ctx: SweepCtx, min: number, maxIncl: number): number => {
  if (ctx.stats) ctx.stats.rollsOther++;
  return ctx.rng ? ctx.rng.int(min, maxIncl) : min;
};

/** TileFrame 生成期（cs:82067） */
function tileFrameGen(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number, _reset: boolean): void {
  // 边距 5 早退（cs:82070）；!active 清 half/slope/块漆早退（cs:82078-82082，
  // ClearBlockPaintAndCoating——RRRR 补块漆清）
  if (x <= 5 || y <= 5 || x >= st.w - 5 || y >= st.h - 5) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) { st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 0; st.paint[i] = 0; return; }
  const sheet = SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]];
  if (sheet < 0) return;
  if (frameImportantDispatch(st, ctx, x, y, sheet)) return;
  // 非实心非 frameImportant：仙人掌 / 藤（cs:82102-82117）
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
  if (!d?.solid) {
    if (sheet === 80) { if (checkCactusSweep(st, ctx, x, y)) return; }
    else if (IS_VINE.has(sheet)) { checkVinesSweep(st, ctx, x, y, sheet); return; }
  }
}

/** TileFrameImportant 分派（cs:85703+）——返回 true=已处理（含 no-op 族） */
function frameImportantDispatch(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number, sheet: number): boolean {
  // frameSparse 模式跳过的读帧族（165/185/28/240族/485/72/C3X2 族——见 SweepCtx 注释）
  if (ctx.frameSparse && (
    sheet === 165 || sheet === 185 || sheet === 28 || sheet === 653 || sheet === 240
    || sheet === 440 || sheet === 485 || sheet === 72 || C3X2_TYPES.has(sheet))) {
    return true;
  }
  switch (sheet) {
    case 518: checkLilyPadSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 519: checkCatTailSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 549: checkSeaweedSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 571: checkBambooSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 72: frame72Sweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 184: frame184Sweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 165:
      // ShimmerPass 1:1（UpdateStalagtiteStyle 掷+杀）；reframe 钩子改走本扫全分派
      // （击杀级联的邻格 184 等须掷骰重查——彼时 165-only 的 frame165 不再等价）
      if (ctx.rng) {
        checkStalactite(st, ctx.rng, x, y, (s2, _r, xx, yy) => tileFrameGen(s2, ctx, xx, yy, false));
      }
      return true;
    case 3: case 24: case 61: case 71: case 73: case 74:
    case 110: case 113: case 201: case 637: case 703:
      plantCheckSweep(st, ctx, x, y, sheet); return true;
    case 13: case 33: case 49: case 50: case 78: case 174: case 372: case 646: case 707:
      checkOnTableSweep(st, ctx, x, y, sheet); return true;
    case 185: checkPileSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 28: case 653: checkPotSweep(st, ctx, x, y, sheet); return true;
    case 240: case 440: check3x3WallSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;

```
